claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: PCI-24781 (abexinostat) is a hydroxamic acid HDAC inhibitor that at 2.5 uM for 5 days kills cells primarily through HDAC inhibition, with a broad antiproliferative/cytotoxic pattern shared with other HDAC inhibitors and chromatin-modifying agents.
